listing.name: Doom RPG / DoomRPG-RE
listing.summary: Play Doom RPG with the upstream Windows player and your prepared original-game data.

steps.title: Prepare your original game data
steps.instruction: The player requires a prepared DoomRPG.zip beside DoomRPG.exe. Follow upstream’s supported preparation for your permitted original Doom RPG data. The included BarToZip.exe converts compatible BREW data; it is a manual preparation tool, not the game player.

steps.title: Select the game player
steps.instruction: Extract and keep the complete Windows package together. Finish Portcove setup with DoomRPG.exe and its containing folder, then choose Play. Do not register BarToZip.exe as the player.

steps.title: Keep progress when updating
steps.instruction: Back up DoomRPG.zip and the working folder’s Config, Player, Player2 and World files before applying upstream updates. The current BarToZip includes PMD-to-WAV conversion; the old separate PureVoice conversion is no longer required.

warnings: Doom RPG and Doom II RPG use different original-game inputs. J2ME and BREW data are not interchangeable merely because a README mentions both.
